name: Boss Plumbing & Heating
tagline: We Pick Up. We Show Up. Done.
brandNarrative:
When your water heater floods the utility room at 6pm on a Thursday, you don't want an answering service — you want Warren. Boss Plumbing & Heating is built around one radical idea: actually be there when things go wrong. Warren has been known to diagnose problems over the phone before a truck ever rolls, drawing on deep knowledge of Philadelphia's neighborhood-specific plumbing quirks. When Andrea in Manayunk called two other plumbers and got voicemail, Warren picked up immediately and had someone on-site in under an hour. When everyone else refused to work a Sunday snow storm, Warren drove out at 5pm and fixed a sewer backup anyway. That's not a policy — that's character.

Boss serves Philadelphia 24 hours a day, every day, and means it. The crew handles everything from sewer line backups and drain clogs to full water heater replacements, working with insurance and HomeServ contracts to take the administrative headache off homeowners. Customers consistently note that the price quoted is the price paid — no surprises. They explain the problem clearly, show up when promised, and finish the job the same day whenever possible. Tim Harding, a new homeowner who inherited a plumbing nightmare, called them 'lifesavers' — and that word keeps coming up in reviews because it keeps being true.

Black-owned and Philadelphia-rooted, Boss Plumbing & Heating has earned a 4.8-star rating across 227 reviews not through marketing but through moments: the flooded basement at midnight, the sewer backup in the snow, the drain that backed up twice and got fixed twice without complaint. This is a business that treats your home like it matters, moves through it respectfully, and leaves the problem solved.
ownerStory:
Warren is the kind of person you call in a crisis — and he answers. As the founder and driving force behind Boss Plumbing & Heating, Warren built his reputation one emergency at a time, often showing up personally when conditions were at their worst. Customers mention him by name not because he's a figurehead but because he's genuinely present: diagnosing issues over the phone with an encyclopedic knowledge of Philly's aging housing stock, taking calls directly at 6pm on weeknights, driving out in snowstorms on Sunday evenings. He doesn't hide behind a dispatch queue.

Warren's approach is to explain, not just fix. New homeowners walk away understanding what went wrong and why. Repeat customers trust the quote they're given. When a drain clog came back after the first visit, his team returned without hesitation or argument. That's the culture Warren has built at Boss — one where the work isn't done until the customer is genuinely taken care of. For Philadelphia homeowners navigating old pipes, century-old infrastructure, and the general chaos of homeownership, Warren has become the name people say when someone asks 'do you know a good plumber?'

reviews.text: Warren was so knowledgeable of our problem and our neighborhood that he was able to diagnose it over the phone! He was also super responsive to our questions. His team was polite about walking through our house (no basement door) and they got all the work done in one day. We will be using them if we ever need another plumber in the future (knock on wood)
reviews.author: Erin and Craig

reviews.text: We had a sewer backup on the weekend during a snow storm.  We have a HomeServ contract for our sewer line so you call them and they get you a licensed plumber to fix the issue.  Because of the weekend and snow storm, everyone refused to come out until they called Warren at Boss Plumbing and Heating.  Warren came out at 5pm on a Sunday in a snow storm and fixed the issue.  He was very professional and did an amazing job. I would highly recommend Boss if you need plumbing help.  Thank you Warren for the help.
reviews.author: Darren Kline

reviews.text: You know what's a pretty solid way to ruin your night?  It's 6pm on a Thursday. Your water heater decides it's done and starts flooding your utility room.  Thank the good Lord for Boss Plumbing and Heating!  I called two other plumbers.  One didn't service our area of Manayunk/Roxborough and the other sent me to voicemail.   Warren picked up immediately.  Not an answering service...  him.  He got a guy out in less than an hour to drain the busted water heater.  Showed up the very next morning with a brand new one.  Perfectly installed.  Great pricing, easy online invoicing and payment.  I couldn't be happier.  As homeowners, Boss will be our go-to plumber from now on!
reviews.author: Andrea McAfee

reviews.text: The people at Boss were lifesavers. Recently bought a house and didn't realize how bad the plumbing/sewage was and they came out promptly and got right on fixing my issue. The price was exactly what they said it would be and were always there when they said they would be. They were super nice to work with and helped me understand what the issue was and fixed it super fast. Made it super easy to work with my insurance too. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Tim Harding

reviews.text: This company was very helpful and nice also understanding.  They unclog my drain and I still had an issue. They came back out with no problem and unclog my drain again. I appreciate the professionalism that they displayed. Black owned businesses And I will highly recommend them. Thank you Warren
reviews.author: Tawaya Lewis

team.name: Warren

His deep knowledge of Philadelphia's housing stock and his genuine care for homeowners have made him the backbone of Boss Plumbing & Heating's 4.8-star reputation.

stats.label: Hours Available, Every Day of the Year

faq.question: Can I actually reach someone after hours or on weekends?
faq.answer: Yes — and it's likely Warren himself who picks up. Multiple customers have called on Sunday evenings, during snowstorms, and at 6pm on weeknights and reached a real person immediately. Boss Plumbing & Heating is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with no answering service buffer.

faq.question: Will the final price match what I was quoted?
faq.answer: Consistently, yes. Customers repeatedly highlight that the price they were quoted was the price they paid — no surprise fees added after the work was done. Invoicing is handled digitally for easy payment and record-keeping.

faq.question: Do you work with home warranty providers like HomeServ?
faq.answer: Yes. Boss Plumbing & Heating is a licensed plumber that works directly with HomeServ and other home warranty contracts, handling the coordination so you don't have to manage the paperwork yourself.

faq.question: What if my problem isn't fully fixed the first time?
faq.answer: Boss stands behind their work. When one customer's drain clog returned after the initial visit, the team came back out without hesitation and resolved it at no additional hassle. They don't consider the job done until you do.

faq.question: How quickly can someone get to my home for an emergency?
faq.answer: Response times are fast — one customer had a technician on-site in under an hour for a water heater emergency. For most urgent calls in the Philadelphia area, same-day service is the standard, not the exception.

faq.question: Do you serve all Philadelphia neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Boss serves a wide range of Philadelphia neighborhoods including Germantown, Manayunk, Roxborough, and surrounding areas. Warren's familiarity with neighborhood-specific plumbing infrastructure often helps him diagnose issues faster than a standard service call.

brandColors.note: Deep navy conveys reliability, trust, and professionalism — essential for a trades business people call during emergencies. The burnt orange accent communicates urgency, energy, and a bold non-corporate personality that matches Warren's direct, show-up-no-matter-what character. Together they feel like a premium independent operation, not a franchise chain.

top_3_strengths: Owner Warren answers calls personally and is consistently available during emergencies, nights, weekends, and severe weather — a rare and deeply valued differentiator in the trades
Transparent, accurate pricing with no surprise costs, combined with easy digital invoicing that modernizes the customer experience
Genuine follow-through and accountability — team returns for unresolved issues without friction, shows up when promised, and explains problems clearly to homeowners
common_complaints: None found — all 5 reviewed reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback, service gaps, or recurring criticisms identified
